P014.title: Global sensitivity analysis for vehicle–track interactions: special attention on track irregularities
P014.authors: L Xu, W Zhai, J Gao
P014.journal_citation: Journal of Computational and Nonlinear Dynamics 13 (3), 031007
P014.label: Xu等（2018）

complete_examples.text: Based on the methods developed in the present study, numerical examples have been conducted to draw the following marks: track irregularities possess the dominant role in guiding the dynamic performance of vehicle–track systems, besides, the vertical stiffness of primary suspension and rail pads also shows significant influence on vertical acceleration of the car body and the wheel–rail vertical force, respectively.

While to the track systems, the rails are modeled as Bernoulli–Euler beams supported by discrete visco-elastic supports with finite length within which the effects of boundary conditions can be ignored, and the rail pads are assumed as linear spring elements and damper elements; the slab tracks are assumed to be thin-plate elements connected to the subgrade through a cement asphalt mortar (CA mortar) layer, which is regarded as continuous plane springs and dashpots.
